crime: One night, while the others comforted a crying girl, {WITCH_NAME} felt a flicker of pleasure. Before she could hide it, the girl beside her saw her face.
Afterward that girl took over her clearing shifts, gave her the better seat, and agreed to everything. To {WITCH_NAME}, such careful kindness meant the girl had seen something monstrous in her.

The day the girl asked to stop sharing their chore, she stayed behind to finish both their work in the dining hall. {WITCH_NAME} came in and struck her with an iron pan as she turned away. The girl fell, pulling a steaming pot off the table. Two prisoners ran in at the crash.
{WITCH_NAME} stood beside the body, her face calm and her breathing even. She said she had just arrived and found the girl dead.
But water from the overturned pot had dried across the front of her sleeves and hem. The two who came running had no such marks. She had been beside the pot when it fell.
fields.epitaph: Everyone had ugly thoughts; only she believed they were all she was.
execution: An iron weight hung above the frame holding her upright under a bright light. The catch held while she cried out and released when she was silent. Facing the other prisoners, she kept her expression calm and made no sound. The weight dropped onto her.

magic.name: Unruffled
magic.text: She can keep her body from revealing what she feels or knows.
